slides.title: Were thousands of Ethiopian workers sent abroad on forged visas?
workers allegedly sent abroad on forged visas
slides.body: to Jordan and other Arab countries, according to charges filed by Ethiopia's Ministry of Justice, Fana reported.

slides.title: people charged
slides.body: including a former manager of the labour market information project. Prosecutors say 1.013 billion birr moved through fraudulent accounts.

slides.title: Families asked to come forward
slides.body: Families who lost contact with relatives working abroad are asked to call the free 991 line. The charges have not yet been proven in court.
